name: Paphos
overview: The city of Paphos in Cyprus is notable in Scripture as the setting where Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, confronts Elymas, a sorcerer who opposed the gospel and sought to turn the Roman deputy Sergius Paulus away from the faith. Paul rebukes Elymas sharply, declaring that God's hand will bring temporary blindness upon him as judgment for his opposition to righteousness, demonstrating the power and authority of God over falsehood and spiritual opposition.
